questions.plain: Which account is this report about, in your own words? For example: "my 2019 auto loan", or "I do not recognise this account".
questions.benefit: This helps separate accounts you recognise from accounts you do not, without changing anything the report itself says.

questions.plain: On this account, are you individually responsible, jointly responsible with someone else, or only an authorised user?
questions.benefit: This helps us distinguish your own accounts from accounts where another person was responsible, again without changing anything the report says.

report_use_question.plain: This assessment is about the credit report you uploaded. What was this report used for?
report_use_question.benefit: Answer about how this report was furnished to a user (for example a lender, insurer or employer), not why you obtained a copy to review. This determines whether a use exception to a retention rule applies, without changing anything the report itself says.

purpose_labels.credit_transaction: A credit transaction (a loan or credit application)
purpose_labels.employment: Employment (a job application or employment decision)

behavior.stored_separately: answers persist on the result row with source CONSUMER_STATEMENT, never merged into report facts
behavior.skip_does_not_interrupt: the clarify HTTP journey test verifies a skipped answer leaves the independent checks intact
behavior.no_escalation: no finding is escalated solely because an answer was supplied
behavior.report_use_material: the governed report-use question names the assessed report and negates an exempted use; it does not unlock a violation; unknown/skip/contradictory/multiple-use/mismatched stay unresolved
